title: Counter-state exit label
statement: Let $k,L$ be natural numbers and let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine. A counter state of type $cA(\tau,t_0)$ exits to the $dA$ label with parameters $\tau,t_0$, and one of type $cB(\tau,t_0)$ exits to the corresponding $dB$ label. States $iz(t_0)$ and $iu(t_0)$ exit to the $hd$ labels carrying those states. A state $lb(t_0)$ exits to the counter label for $lt$ at phase $0$ if $t_0$ is true, and otherwise to the $hd$ label for $lay$; a state of type $lt$ exits to the $hd$ label for $lay$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Boolean Turing machine M
